subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted gateway disconnects land as a focused fresh-session recook-first fallback after the retry-exhaustion repair, or should this PR be expanded or paused for the reattach-first design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The code defect has a narrow repair, but the remaining behavior intentionally trades same-session safety for possible double model/tool execution and double delivery.

options.title: Land focused fix after retry repair
options.body: Fix the retry-exhaustion hole, keep the fresh-session recook-first boundary for now, and leave reattach-first behavior in the related product issue.

options.title: Expand to reattach-first
options.body: Use this branch as the vehicle for `agent.wait`/transcript recovery before any local recook fallback, accepting the larger behavior change now.

options.title: Pause pending direction
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until maintainers choose the accepted-disconnect recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix after retry repair
recommendation.body: Fix the retry-exhaustion hole, keep the fresh-session recook-first boundary for now, and leave reattach-first behavior in the related product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent `agent-via-gateway` history shows repeated gateway CLI dispatch ownership in the affected file.
